ActivationRequestSchema.description:
Explicit activation of one indexed bundle.

The consumer scope is resolved server-side, never from the request body: a
client cannot choose which scope's active profile it mutates.
ActivationRequestSchema.title: ActivationRequestSchema

ActivationResultSchema.description: Outcome of one activation or rollback.
ActivationResultSchema.title: ActivationResultSchema

ChunkBundleSchema.description: Read-only view of one registered chunk bundle.
ChunkBundleSchema.title: ChunkBundleSchema

ChunkBundleSummarySchema.description: Chunk bundle plus the embedding bundles already produced from it.
ChunkBundleSummarySchema.title: ChunkBundleSummarySchema

CorpusOrganizationPolicy.description:
Política de organización/navegación del corpus de un proyecto.

Define la vista de ingreso y los relpaths lógicos; **nunca** la identidad del
documento ni la ubicación canónica de artefactos sellados (plan §Fase 1).
CorpusOrganizationPolicy.title: CorpusOrganizationPolicy

CreateCorpusSnapshotRequestSchema.description:
Congela un snapshot inmutable; el server valida elegibilidad fail-closed.

``project_id`` es el ID **canónico completo** (``proj_...``), igual que en el
resto de rutas; el server lo valida y deriva el slug. Nunca el slug crudo.
CreateCorpusSnapshotRequestSchema.title: CreateCorpusSnapshotRequestSchema

CreateProjectRequestSchema.description:
Alta de proyecto por HTTP.

**No** expone ``target_bindings``: un binding acopla ``binding_key`` a un
``indexing_target_id`` físico, y el contrato prohíbe que el cliente elija el
target físico (invariante §Seguridad). Los bindings se provisionan
server-side (seed/admin) y se leen versionados; el cliente solo declara
plantilla, política y perfiles de embedding (identidades lógicas globales).
CreateProjectRequestSchema.title: CreateProjectRequestSchema

CreateReleaseDraftRequestSchema.description: DRAFT: solo la clave lógica ``target_binding_key`` (nunca IDs físicos).
CreateReleaseDraftRequestSchema.title: CreateReleaseDraftRequestSchema

CreateRetrievalProfileSchema.description: Register one retrieval profile under the server-controlled consumer scope.
CreateRetrievalProfileSchema.title: CreateRetrievalProfileSchema

CreateVariantRequestSchema.description: Solo selección de celda de matriz reconfirmada (nunca IDs físicos libres).
CreateVariantRequestSchema.title: CreateVariantRequestSchema

DocumentTypeTemplate.description:
Plantillas seleccionables de taxonomía documental.

``GENERIC`` es neutral y es la única preseleccionable por defecto; ``SST`` es
la plantilla versionada que ``sst-general`` toma como base (ADR-006, plan
§Fase 1). Un proyecto nuevo no preselecciona ``SST``.
DocumentTypeTemplate.title: DocumentTypeTemplate

EmbeddingBundleChunkSchema.description: One row of the durable chunk map. Never carries a vector.
EmbeddingBundleChunkSchema.title: EmbeddingBundleChunkSchema

EmbeddingBundleSchema.description: Durable state of one embedding bundle. Never carries vectors.
EmbeddingBundleSchema.title: EmbeddingBundleSchema

EmbeddingIndexingReadinessSchema.description: Whether a bundle may be handed to Indexing.
EmbeddingIndexingReadinessSchema.title: EmbeddingIndexingReadinessSchema

EmbeddingRunRequestSchema.description: MVP payload: exactly one chunk bundle and one profile.
EmbeddingRunRequestSchema.title: EmbeddingRunRequestSchema

EmbeddingRunSchema.description: Durable state of one embedding run.
EmbeddingRunSchema.title: EmbeddingRunSchema

EmbeddingRuntimeSchema.description: Operational availability of the engine behind one profile.
EmbeddingRuntimeSchema.title: EmbeddingRuntimeSchema

ErrorBodySchema.description: Body of the shared error envelope.
ErrorBodySchema.title: ErrorBodySchema

ErrorEnvelopeSchema.description: Every non-2xx response uses this envelope.
ErrorEnvelopeSchema.title: ErrorEnvelopeSchema

IndexingOverviewSchema.description: Aggregate state of the bundle-first indexing surface.
IndexingOverviewSchema.title: IndexingOverviewSchema

IndexingRetrievalReadinessSchema.description: Whether an indexed run can actually serve retrieval traffic.
IndexingRetrievalReadinessSchema.title: IndexingRetrievalReadinessSchema

IndexingRunDocumentSchema.description: Per-document outcome of one indexing run.
IndexingRunDocumentSchema.title: IndexingRunDocumentSchema

IndexingRunRequestSchema.description: MVP payload: only the sealed embedding bundle.
IndexingRunRequestSchema.title: IndexingRunRequestSchema

IndexingRunSchema.description: Durable state of one indexing run.
IndexingRunSchema.title: IndexingRunSchema

IndexingTargetSchema.description: Read-only view of one physical pgvector table.
IndexingTargetSchema.title: IndexingTargetSchema

ProjectDocumentType.description:
Un tipo documental permitido por el catálogo del proyecto.

Attributes:
    code: Identificador estable dentro del proyecto (slug).
    display_name: Nombre legible mostrado en la UI.
    template: Plantilla de la que proviene el tipo.
ProjectDocumentType.title: ProjectDocumentType

ProjectEmbeddingProfile.description:
Perfil de embedding habilitado para un proyecto.

``embedding_profile_id`` referencia un recurso global (ADR-005); el proyecto
solo declara que puede usarlo, no lo redefine.
ProjectEmbeddingProfile.title: ProjectEmbeddingProfile

RetrievalProfileSchema.description: Read-only view of one retrieval profile.
RetrievalProfileSchema.title: RetrievalProfileSchema

RetrievalProfileStatusSchema.description: Profile, runtime and readiness in one payload.
RetrievalProfileStatusSchema.title: RetrievalProfileStatusSchema

RetrievalReadinessSchema.description: Every precondition retrieval needs, evaluated together.
RetrievalReadinessSchema.title: RetrievalReadinessSchema

RetrievalRuntimeSchema.description: Whether the query engine behind one retrieval profile can run today.
RetrievalRuntimeSchema.title: RetrievalRuntimeSchema

RetrievalSearchResponseSchema.description: Evidence returned by one retrieval search.
RetrievalSearchResponseSchema.title: RetrievalSearchResponseSchema

RetrievalValidationSchema.description: Result of a controlled smoke validation.
RetrievalValidationSchema.title: RetrievalValidationSchema

RetrievedEvidenceSchema.description: One evidence item returned by retrieval search.
RetrievedEvidenceSchema.title: RetrievedEvidenceSchema

RollbackRequestSchema.description:
Revert one lane to a bundle that was already validated.

The consumer scope is resolved server-side (see ``ActivationRequestSchema``).
RollbackRequestSchema.title: RollbackRequestSchema

SearchRetrievalSchema.description: Run one retrieval search against one retrieval profile.
SearchRetrievalSchema.title: SearchRetrievalSchema

UpdateProjectConfigurationRequestSchema.description:
Nueva versión de configuración por HTTP.

Igual que el alta, **no** expone ``target_bindings`` (no filtra el target
físico al OpenAPI ni al frontend de Fase 8). El versionado de bindings es
server-side.
UpdateProjectConfigurationRequestSchema.title: UpdateProjectConfigurationRequestSchema

UpdateProjectRequestSchema.description: Metadatos mutables de un proyecto (solo ``display_name``; identidad inmutable).
UpdateProjectRequestSchema.title: UpdateProjectRequestSchema

ValidateRetrievalSchema.description: Run a controlled smoke validation against one retrieval profile.
ValidateRetrievalSchema.title: ValidateRetrievalSchema

ValidationCheckSchema.description: One named assertion of a validation report.
ValidationCheckSchema.title: ValidationCheckSchema

embedding__api__schemas__EmbeddingProfil.title: EmbeddingProfileSchema
